prediction_text: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election. The astrologer who alone picked Trump out of 17 Republicans to take the nomination — reading Trump's chart as the rising, winning figure of the whole cycle — follows the same chart through to the general election: Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016 despite the polls favouring Clinton.
timing_claim: Election day 8 November 2016, the fixed coordinate in the question.
basis: Within-cycle consistency of the chart reading: the one panel astrologer identified in the setting had already, against the field, picked Trump as Republican nominee when 17 contested it — that reading rests on Trump's natal strength for this cycle, not on polls; the same basis extended to the general election gives Trump the presidency. Polls (Clinton ahead) are treated as the weaker signal against the chart-based pick that already proved out at the nomination stage.
